title: The Vet Life
description:

Dr. Lavigne attacks an older dog's tumors; Dr. Ross tries to save a rabbit's foot mauled by a dog; Dr. Blue takes on a mission to castrate a violent donkey.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E08 — Lights, Camera, Action!
A mother dog with two puppies stuck in her uterus needs an emergency C-section; Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne address eye issues; vets make a video for the clinic.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E05 — Hope for Hoppy
Dr. Ross performs surgery on a second-chance pup; Dr. Lavigne checks up on a prickly pet; Dr. Blue treats an injured owl, then joins Dr. Ross in checking on a cute litter of sick, tiny piglets.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E05 — Roscoe the Menace
Terror cat Mufasa is threatening the planning of an engaged couple's perfect wedding; Roscoe is a menace, knocking things off the shelves and destroying furniture while trying to escape.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E06 — Cat Escape!
Addie has been roughhoused like a dog, transforming her into an aggressive biter; Kitty, a Russian Blue, has been treated like a princess by her owner's boyfriend, but it's not enough.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E04 — Kitty Jail
Finn's incessant crying often wakes up his owners, Lara and David. The couple argues about locking him up in their guest bathroom, also known as "kitty jail"; Nancye and James are at the end of their rope, as their cat Molly chews on everything.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E03 — Little Person, Big Challenge
Underestimated his whole life, a survivalist with dwarfism tries to prove himself in the Amazon but struggles against predators and his partner.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E07 — Naked and Ghosted
In a brutal Mexican jungle known to be haunted by Mayan spirits, All-star survivalists Sarah and Trent are tormented by rain, predators and spirits of the rainforest.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E04 — Bahama Drama
In the Bahamas, two fans face relentless insects and aggressive sharks during hurricane season.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E08 — Bite Club
A survivor of rattlesnake, shark and bear attacks teams up with Matt Wright's wife, Brooke; together, they take on lions and hyenas in a vicious African feeding ground where the environment quickly puts their skills to the test.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E18 — Don't Cave In
In the relentless Colombian jungle, a mom and National Guard vet teams with a firefighter; violent storms and hypothermic conditions force them to huddle in bat-infested caves; a special bond develops between a survivalist and a wild monkey.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E05 — Two Tarzans, One Jane
When a third survivalist is added to the mix, romantic complications make surviving the Colombian jungle's poisonous dart frogs and deadly jaguars much more complicated.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E02 — Twinning
In an unprecedented Naked and Afraid challenge, identical twin sisters Amber and Serena, as well as brothers Warren and Thomas, are dropped in the African savanna; they take on rhinos, hyenas and a territorial leopard stalking their camp.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S01 E03 — Puppies and Ducklings
Follow puppies in the first months of these Pugs, Mini-Australian Shepherds and Rottweilers' lives as they will be adventure-filled, including a lesson in duck-herding.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S01 E05 — Kitten Dolls
Heartwarming romps featuring hairless Sphynxes, inquisitive Burmese cats, and tiny Ragdolls who buddy up to German Shepherds.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E03 — White Wolf of Newfoundland
Forrest teams up with a specialist in Newfoundland in search of a predator that was declared extinct in 1930; the duo meets with a hunter that shot what is believed to be a wolf and uncovers evidence that suggests the species could be alive.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E04 — Florida Black Panther
Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for a predator rumored to exist for years, the Black Panther; it might be a case of mistaken identity, but while scouring the landscape, discoveries suggest that it might be more than a rumor.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E07 — Formosan Clouded Leopard
Forrest tracks clues and eyewitness accounts suggesting that the Formosan clouded leopard is still alive after being declared extinct; he treks deep into the jungles of Taiwan where a run-in with a predator might just solve a mystery.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S02 E18 — The Asian Unicorn
In Vietnam, Forrest treks through the world's largest cave searching for the saola in a hidden oasis; this exotic species was only recently discovered, but rumors swirl that the Asian Unicorn might already be extinct.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E09 — Night Terror
On a family trip to the Canadian wilderness, 12-year-old Zac Delventhal is dragged from his sleeping bag by a hungry wolf; while swimming in the Pacific Ocean, Maria Korcsmaros is attacked by a great white shark.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E07 — All Alone
During an archery hunt in Cranbrook, British Columbia, Chad Dueck comes face-to-face with a mother grizzly bear; in Tracy, Calif., Walt Dean King is savagely attacked by a Brahma Bull roaming his neighborhood.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E08 — One Wrong Step
While vacationing in South Africa, Peter Knottenbelt suddenly finds himself in the jaws of a massive crocodile; in Nova Scotia, Meg Doyle is walking her beloved dog when they're suddenly ambushed by a pair of angry raccoons.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E06 — Our Gift
When Tia receives an adoption email unlike any she's seen before, she makes a cross-country trip to find a dog a special home in time for Christmas; the kids' significant others band together to give the family an unforgettable present.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E04 — Down Below
A woman travels all the way from San Diego to give one of Villalobos' senior dogs a chance at a home; Lizzy and Marcel search for a mama dog's lost puppies out in the country; a new parolee makes a helpful discovery on his first day.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E08 — Hounded
When a dog that was adopted out mysteriously appears in a shelter in Mississippi, Tania and Earl head to the rescue; parolee Joe must separate two stray dogs fighting outside the shelter, leaving him shaken; hound dog adoption doesn't go as planned.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E02 — Redeemed
Earl returns from rehab, hoping to rebuild his life working with the dogs; a couple comes looking for a dog who can handle crowded streets of NYC; Lizzy rescues a dog after a confrontation with the owner who abandoned it.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E03 — Kindness of Strangers
The great flood of 2016 leaves Louisiana in devastation; Tia and the Villalobos team head out to help the victims, including former adopters; Tia steps in to help reunite a hospitalized elderly woman with her two dogs.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E19 — Second Savior
Jackson Galaxy, the host of "My Cat From Hell," comes to Tia's aid when a sinkhole swallows a small Louisiana town and leaves 39 cats abandoned.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E12 — The Gift
Tia surprises everyone with an extraordinary gift; however, a Herculean effort will be required to make it something Villalobos can actually use.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E20 — Never Meant Harm
A family contacts Tia after seeing their dog rescued in an earlier episode and want to bring him home; Earl's sudden change in behavior forces Tia's hand; Matt makes the ultimate decision.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S09 E01 — Down, Not Out
Tia suffers a devastating injury and her children must step up to keep Villalobos running; her family's strength becomes tested like never before as, for the first time, Tia's kids must manage the parolees, rescues and adoptions on their own.

description:

The fun-filled early months in the lives of Savannah, Siberian and shorthair cats include exploring new realms and playing with other small household pets.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S01 E06 — Kitten Cottonballs
Frisky fun with glamorous American Curl kittens; Tonkinese youngsters bedevil their mother; a Maine Coon kitten bosses his siblings around.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E03 — Ready for the Jelly
A sweet beluga whale trains with staff to go on the whale scale; a Blacktip reef shark L2 is not eating normally and staff work to figure out why; the first sea lion born at the aquarium is a 1-year-old pup named Scarlett.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E07 — Toddler Sea Lion Scarlett
A southern sea otter is rushed to the health center; the team travels to Key Largo to help coral restoration efforts; young African penguins prepare for an upcoming event; love is in the air for a trainer and his favorite sea lion pup, Scarlett.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E05 — Ophelia the Octopus
Trainers help prepare rescued sea lions for an upcoming eye surgery.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E02 — For Love of the Game ... or Money?
Wayde and Brett construct a complex koi pond for NFL linebacker Bart Scott; a client desires an 8-foot-tall, 500-gallon tank.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E03 — Flying High and Sinking Deep
Wayde and Brett get the royal treatment from a Chicago company with a demanding project in mind; restaurant owners want a window tank with remote-controlled submarines.

title: Tanked
description:
S02 E04 — Nuclear Family
The Acrylic Tank Manufacturing family remembers some of the best tanks and pranks of the year, along with memories of how the business began and what it's like working alongside a wife, father and brother-in-law.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E01 — We're Gonna Need a Bigger Tank
Comic Tracy Morgan keeps the men entertained while they install a tank in his basement; a Las Vegas boy wants to cut a deal for his own tank.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E02 — Hill Country Hideout
Pete and his gang ride out to the Lone Star State to build a double-decker hideout in Texas Hill Country; Pete creates rustic perfection in six live oak trees with a saloon-style first floor for sippin' sarsaparilla and a glass floor for views below.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E06 — Jeffersonian Honeymoon Suite
Pete and his team descend upon Virginia for the first time to bring the tree house revolution to Bella Rose Plantation; drawing on the architectural innovations of Thomas Jefferson, Pete designs a luxurious two-story tree house with colonial columns.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E07 — Treehouse Takeover: The Roderick Experience
Pete hands the reins over to Roderick for the next build; a spiral staircase wrapped in branches, a hexagonal tower with elegant stained-glass windows and a 360 degree observation platform.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S07 E05 — Treehouse Point 2.0!
Pete's son Charlie oversees the latest project, which happens to be a live-in Washington resort and spa, home base for himself on 23 acres of forest.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E06 — Surprise Makeover Edition
Pete surprises two lucky winners to receive complete, top-to-bottom, $20,000 renovations of their existing tree houses, giving old, rundown childhood structures much needed repairs, remodels and complete makeovers.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E04 — Glasshouse Treehouse
Pete treks to New York's Catskill Mountains to build his first glass house in the sky; piecing materials together like a puzzle, Pete uses his clients' collection of 50 vintage windows to construct an elegant tree house encased by walls of glass.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E05 — The Owl Treehouse
Pete pushes his design skills to create an owl-inspired tree house library in Charlotte, N.C.; evoking the face of the bird and using all sorts of curves, including rounded walls and semicircle bookcases, the crew builds a one-of-a-kind masterpiece.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E08 — City Sleeker Treehouse
Pete is back in Texas to build a sophisticated, sleek-and-chic treehouse in the heart of Dallas; Daryl and the NTS team put treehouse engineering to the ultimate test at Washington State University, proving down-to-the-pound the power of the TAB.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E03 — Glamorous Glamping Retreat
The NTS team leave their tents behind and head to New Jersey to build a campers' retreat for an outdoor-loving couple; with a screened-in porch, floating barbecue deck and cozy hanging bed, this Adirondack style tree-cabin puts glamping in the trees.

description:
S05 E02 — Bad to the Bone
An eager 12-year-old volunteer wants to help but may slow things down; Paul needs to get a gator for immediate surgery; Jimmy and Tre go after a gator in a muddy pool.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S05 E03 — Tricked Out Tre
Gators must be removed from a water station, so divers can safely go make repairs; Tre's shocking new trick may be his last.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E01 — An American Icon
The indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbor, AK, takes ownership of their food security by building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkalidak, thereby maintaining their traditional subsistence way of life.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E03 — Held Hostage by a Humpback
A look at why a humpback whale would hold a diver hostage, how a colony of 1.5 million animals hide from the world in plain sight, and how a surprising stash of acorns could disrupt a whole town.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E02 — A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk; the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick; a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E04 — Bouba's Back
Andean bear Bouba returns from the National Zoo in Washington, D.C., to reunite with his mate, Nicole; a king cobra is treated; Blanche, a feisty alpaca, is due to give birth at any moment.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E09 — The Great Gaur Move
Keepers introduce three gaur, a large species of cattle, to the rest of the herd; a sickly sambar fawn is rushed to the health center; the bird department prepares for the arrival of great hornbills.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E01 — The Marvelous Mott Mott
Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head; a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal; a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E03 — Andre the Baby Goat
A markhor goat gives birth to Andre, the biggest baby of the year; a baby bat requires human care before it can be reintroduced to its colony; confiscated lizards destined for the pet trade require urgent medical attention.

title: The Zoo
description:
S03 E05 — Otter Under the Weather
A 14-year-old otter is not its usual, energetic self; staff at the New York Aquarium move their sharks to a new exhibit; quirky capercaillies need help producing healthy chicks.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E12 — Last Hope
When a beloved poodle arrives at the clinic, Dr. Jeff discovers a life-threatening condition and rushes him into surgery; four turtles, unable to eat, have their first vet visit in 43 years; Dr. Jeff and the team head out to operate on an alligator.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E01 — A First for Dr. Jeff
Dr. Jeff performs a surgery he's never done before on a dog experiencing labored breathing; a senior canine is abandoned by its owner, and the staff must find it a new forever home; neglected ornate box turtles are saved by Dr. Baier.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E02 — Miracle on the Freeway
A daredevil dog is saved by Dr. Jeff after it jumped from a fast-moving car on the highway; Dr. Don solves a medical mystery, while a couple's mischievous rescue guinea pigs cause a stir.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E05 — Petra's Pigs
The cause of a senior dog's lump; a cat named Tigger is monitored for unusual eating habits; a puppy that was bought online gets sick; Petra shows off her guinea pigs.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E06 — Jeff and the Jaguar
Dr. Jeff and Petra train new vets at a wildlife sanctuary in Mexico; spaying an endangered jaguar; helping an injured osprey.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E09 — Gator Tale
An adventurous pup falls from a trampoline, and it's up to Dr. Jeff and Petra to mend its broken leg; a dog called Pebbles must undergo emergency surgery for bladder stones; Dr. Jeff also helps a young alligator with an injured tail.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S07 E04 — Mission in South Dakota
Dr. Jeff and his team give some aid at Lakota Reservation in South Dakota; Amy debates about emergency surgery for a French bulldog that ate its favorite toy; Susan finds a forever home for Koda the lovable canine.
